title: SEC Drops Enforcement Case Against Winklevoss-Founded Crypto Exchange Gemini
summary: The SEC has agreed to dismiss its enforcement case against Gemini after investors in its defunct lending program recovered their crypto assets in full. The post SEC Drops Enforcement Case Against Winklevoss-Founded Crypto Exchange Gemini appeared first on Cryptonews .
